sources.title: GitHub - aimerib/spoomplesmaxx
sources.snippet: These datasets are designed to train a Roleplay (RP), Creative Writing, and "Smart" Assistant model Spoomplesmaxx. The goal of combining these specific sets is to create a model that is narratively creative and capable of embodying characters, but also logically sound and capable of following complex instructions.

sources.title: aimeri/spoomplesmaxx-mini-14B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SpoomplesMaxx is a generalist model with primary strengths in creative writing and roleplay, plus light competence at instruction following and reasoning. The Mini brings the v2.1 data and training recipe to a 14B you can run on a single 24GB card.

sources.title: GGUF Dossier — Model Intelligence Files
sources.snippet: GGUF Dossier Model Intelligence Analysis System You have a .gguf model file and you want to know what's actually inside it. That's exactly what this is for. Think of it as a filing system for quantized AI models — full intelligence report, no PhD required.
